text: The mean of the first ten even natural numbers is
explanation: First ten even natural numbers: 2, 4, 6, ..., 20. Sum = 2(1+2+...+10) = 2 × 55 = 110. Mean = 110/10 = 11.

text: The average of the first five multiples of 3 is
explanation: First five multiples of 3: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. Average = (3 + 6 + 9 + 12 + 15) / 5 = 45 / 5 = 9.

text: The average of the first 100 positive integers is
explanation: Sum of first 100 positive integers = 100 × 101 / 2 = 5050. Average = 5050 / 100 = 50.5.

text: The average of odd numbers up to 100 is
explanation: Odd numbers from 1 to 99: there are 50 odd numbers. Sum = 50² = 2500. Average = 2500/50 = 50.

text: In a family, the average age of a father and a mother is 35 years. The average age of the father, mother and their only son is 27 years. What is the age of the son?
explanation: Sum of ages of father and mother = 35 × 2 = 70. Sum of ages of all three = 27 × 3 = 81. Son's age = 81 − 70 = 11 years.

The average marks of a student in 4 subjects is 75. If the student obtained 80 marks in the fifth subject, then the new average is
explanation: Sum of marks in 4 subjects = 75 × 4 = 300. Sum of 5 subjects = 300 + 80 = 380. New average = 380/5 = 76.

text: Total of Arun's marks in Sanskrit and Mathematics together are 80 more than his marks in Science. His average marks in the three subjects are 100. What are his marks in Science?
explanation: Let Science = Sc. Sanskrit + Maths = Sc + 80. Total = Sc + 80 + Sc = 300. So 2Sc = 220, Sc = 110.

text: A, B, C and D are four consecutive even numbers respectively and their average is 65. What is the product of A and D?
explanation: Let numbers be x, x+2, x+4, x+6. Average = (4x+12)/4 = 65 → x = 62. A = 62, D = 68. Product = 62 × 68 = 4216.

The average of five consecutive numbers is x. If the next two numbers are also included, how shall the average vary?
explanation: Let five consecutive numbers be z, z+1, z+2, z+3, z+4. Average = z+2 = x. Including z+5 and z+6, new average = (7z+21)/7 = z+3 = x+1. Average increases by 1.

text: In a class there are 32 boys and 28 girls. The average age of the boys in the class is 14 years and the average age of the girls in the class is 13 years. What is the average age of the whole class (rounded to two digits after decimal)?
A batsman makes a score of 87 runs in the 17th inning and thus increases his average by 3. Find his average after 17th inning.
explanation: Let average after 17th inning = x. Average after 16th = (x−3). So 16(x−3) + 87 = 17x → 16x − 48 + 87 = 17x → x = 39.

text: In a class there are 50 students. Their average weight is 45 kg. When a student leaves the class, the average is reduced by 100 g. Find the weight of the student who left the class.
explanation: Total weight = 45 × 50 = 2250 kg. New average = 44.9 kg. Weight of 49 students = 44.9 × 49 = 2200.1. Weight of student who left = 2250 − 2200.1 = 49.9 kg.

text: The average age of a class of 39 students is 15 years. If the age of the teacher be included, then the average increases by 3 months. Find the age of the teacher.
explanation: Total age of 39 students = 39 × 15 = 585 years. New average = 15 years 3 months = 61/4 years. Total of 40 persons = (61/4) × 40 = 610. Teacher's age = 610 − 585 = 25 years.

The average of 10 numbers is 40.2. Later it is found that two numbers have been wrongly added. The first is 18 greater than the actual number and the second number added is 13 instead of 33. Find the correct average.
explanation: Incorrect sum = 40.2 × 10 = 402. First number is 18 more, so subtract 18. Second: 13 was added instead of 33, so add 20. Correct sum = 402 − 18 + 20 = 404. Correct average = 404/10 = 40.4.

text: The average weight of a class of 24 students is 35 kg. If the weight of the teacher be included, the average rises by 400 g. The weight of the teacher is
explanation: Total weight of 24 students = 35 × 24 = 840 kg. New average = 35.4 kg. Total of 25 = 35.4 × 25 = 885. Teacher's weight = 885 − 840 = 45 kg.

text: The average weight of 8 men is increased by 1.5 kg when one of the men, who weighs 65 kg is replaced by a new man. The weight of the new man is
explanation: Total weight increased = 8 × 1.5 = 12 kg. Weight of new man = 65 + 12 = 77 kg.

text: The batting average for 40 innings of a cricket player is 50 runs. His highest score in an innings exceeds his lowest score by 172 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average of remaining 38 innings is 48. Find his highest score in an innings.

10 years ago, the average age of a family of 4 members was 24 years. Since then, two children have been born, still the average age of the family is the same today. If the two children differ in age by 2 years, find the present age of the younger child.
explanation: Total age 10 years ago = 24 × 4 = 96. Now total of original 4 members = 96 + 40 = 136. Now 6 members with average 24, total = 144. Sum of 2 children = 144 − 136 = 8. If ages are x and x+2: 2x + 2 = 8, x = 3.

text: A car owner buys petrol at ₹ 17, ₹ 19 and ₹ 20 per litre for three consecutive years. Compute the average cost per litre, if he spends ₹ 6460 per year.
explanation: Litres bought each year: 6460/17 = 380, 6460/19 = 340, 6460/20 = 323. Total litres = 1043. Total spent = 6460 × 3 = 19380. Average cost = 19380/1043 ≈ ₹ 18.58.

explanation: For 7 consecutive numbers, the average equals the middle (4th) number = 20. The numbers are 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23. Largest = 23.

The average age of a husband and wife was 23 years at the time of their marriage. After five years they have a one-year old child. The average age of the family now is
explanation: Sum of ages at marriage = 23 × 2 = 46. After 5 years, sum of husband & wife = 46 + 10 = 56. Child = 1 year. Total = 57. Average = 57/3 = 19 years.

text: The average of 11 results is 60. If the average of first six results is 58 and that of last six is 63, find the 6th result.
explanation: Total of 11 results = 60 × 11 = 660. Total of first 6 = 58 × 6 = 348. Total of last 6 = 63 × 6 = 378. 6th result = 348 + 378 − 660 = 66.

text: The average age of 10 persons learning yoga is 32 years. When the age of their instructor is added, the average age becomes 34 years. The age of their instructor is
explanation: Total age of 10 persons = 32 × 10 = 320. Total of 11 persons = 34 × 11 = 374. Instructor's age = 374 − 320 = 54 years.
